data.title: 英梨梨 · 不许碰左边那张
data.description: 桌上的墨线还没有干。英梨梨用手掌挡住那页画稿，另一只手捏着橡皮，示意你先看右边已经完成的分镜。
data.promptProse: In her studio, Eriri wears a green tracksuit jacket and navy lounge shorts. Seated at a drawing desk, she keeps one open hand above a freshly inked page while holding an eraser in the other, directing the viewer toward the finished storyboard on her right. A desk lamp illuminates the paper.
data.animaCaption: Her open palm guards the wet ink without touching it; the eraser stays over a separate page.
data.action: 护住未干的墨线，示意先看另一张分镜
